title: Chronos Time Laboratory
tagline: Ten real physics experiments about time: make a guess, move a slider, see what happens.
stateNote: Runs in the browser. Illustrations are labelled as not to scale.
problem: Time dilation and other strange facts about time are hard to picture from equations. Each experiment asks for a guess first, then lets you try it.
audience: Curious people with no physics background.
contribution: It is my project. I haven't linked a public repository for it.
worksToday: Ten experiments, starting with the 1977 muon lifetime result, as shown on the site.
Each one follows guess, try it, then explain.
limitations: I've checked that the first experiment loads, not all ten.
The visuals are illustrations, not simulations to scale.
